candidate_question: Which direction can the headlamp beam be adjusted?
claim_texts: The manual describes vertical adjustment using the adjusting screw turned clockwise or anticlockwise. It does not map each direction to up/down or supply an aiming distance/height in this guidance, so I cannot prescribe a precise aim setting. Authorised service can set it.
